name: Write File
description: Create, overwrite, or append a text file under the workplace root.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write UTF-8 content to a file. mode=overwrite (default) replaces the whole file; mode=create fails if the file exists (safe new files); mode=append adds to the end. Prefer str_replace or patch for surgical edits. Creates parent directories.

path.description: File path relative to workplace root (or absolute under that root).

content.description: Full content to write (or to append).

mode.description: create = fail if exists; overwrite = replace (default); append = add to end.

overwrite.description: Legacy: false forces mode=create. Prefer mode.
